column1: # Stock DreamSeeker x stock DreamDaemon 516.1689, 2026-11-24, world.dm here.
# Driven by tools/stockprobe/stockprobe.py click (posted mouse messages; the open menu walked with posted arrow keys) and
# read from the world's log. Points are client-area pixels of the 576x384 map. Stock draws the atom names of its menu
# itself, so an entry is known by its place from the top and by what its verbs ran on.
# part A: the menu a right click on a holder's vis_contents member lists, topmost first. Each entry is the verbs it
# offers; the last entry is always the floor turf the holder stands on.
# part B: a verb picked from an entry and the atom it ran on, as the world logged it (name and x,y,z; - is nothing
# logged). member is what the holder's vis_contents holds: a mob (- for one with no loc) or a turf, at its own x,y,z.
# part C: the left button pressed on jumper (336,80), whose MouseDown moves the mob to z 2 three ticks later, and
# released at the same point two seconds after. The release is an ordinary one on the new z.
